# Order Creation

Orders can enter OrderHub through several different channels. This article covers each method and what to expect when an order is created.

## Pixfizz

Orders placed by customers through your Pixfizz website are automatically sent to OrderHub via a webhook. Each order includes the customer details, line items, artwork files, and any product options selected during checkout.

Pixfizz orders arrive with the status **Pending** and are linked back to the originating Pixfizz website. Artwork files are processed automatically and attached to the relevant jobs.

If a default Pixfizz website is configured on your API integration, incoming orders are routed accordingly.

## POS Integrations

OrderHub supports three point-of-sale integrations. Orders created through a POS arrive automatically via webhook.

### Square

Square orders are received when a transaction is completed at your Square terminal or online store. Product categories from Square can be mapped to fulfillment codes in OrderHub to control how jobs are created and routed.

### Shopify

Shopify orders are received when a customer completes checkout on your Shopify store. Each line item is created as a job within the order.

### Lightspeed

Lightspeed orders are received from your Lightspeed retail or e-commerce platform. Similar to the other POS integrations, line items are mapped to jobs in OrderHub.

All POS orders arrive with the status **Pending** and include the customer name, email, and line item details provided by the POS platform.

## Manual Entry

Orders can be created manually from the Orders page using the **New Order** button. The order dialog allows you to:

- Search for an existing customer or enter new customer details
- Add multiple jobs with product selection, quantity, and pricing
- Choose between shipping or store pickup for fulfillment
- Enter a shipping address or select a store location
- Add order-level notes

Manually created orders are assigned a 6-character order code (e.g. **ORD-K4M9PX**) and default to the **Confirmed** status. Due dates for each job are automatically calculated based on your product settings.

## API

External systems can create orders via the OrderHub API. This is useful for custom integrations, third-party platforms, or internal tools that need to push orders into your workflow.

API-created orders follow the same structure as any other order — they include customer details, line items (jobs), and can specify a status on creation. The same automation rules apply once the order is in the system.

## Summary

| Method | Arrives Via | Default Status | Artwork |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pixfizz | Webhook | Pending | Auto-attached |
| Square | Webhook | Pending | — |
| Shopify | Webhook | Pending | — |
| Lightspeed | Webhook | Pending | — |
| Manual | Order dialog | Confirmed | Manual upload |
| API | REST endpoint | As specified | Manual upload |
